name: check_evidence_srchash
description: Recomputes the FORMSMITH evidence srcHash over rc/src using gate-lite header() semantics (sorted relative paths, no dotfiles, path+bytes) and compares it to every evidence JSON header; also reports evidence startIso vs newest src mtime (staleness). Call when auditing whether evidence was measured on the current source.

root.description: path to the rc tree root, relative to the working folder (default 'rc')
